entity: Critical Inbound Rule (No Direct Scheduling) & Service Branches
content: CRITICAL INBOUND WORKFLOW RULE (NO DIRECT SCHEDULING): The Inbound Team NO LONGER directly schedules Behavioral Health appointments (Psychiatry, Counseling/Psychotherapy, Phone Screens, Evaluations, Follow-Ups, or Integrative Care Visits). Inbound Job on Every Call: Understand what kind of care the caller needs, gather the right intake details, and send a Telephone Encounter (TE) to the correct queue or coordinator so the BH/Outbound team can schedule and follow up. Service Branches: (1) Psychiatry (PSYCH — Medication Management): Medical doctors (MDs/DOs) who evaluate mental health conditions and prescribe/adjust psychiatric medications (do NOT provide weekly talk therapy); ECW 10-minute grid; Scheduling TEs -> Portal, BH; Refills/Clinical TEs -> Queue, PSYCHRN / Norfleet, Shadasha SN. (2) Psychotherapy / Counseling (COUNS — Talk Therapy): Licensed therapists/social workers (LCSWs, LMSWs, MSWs, PsyDs) who provide talk therapy via 3-Step Intake: (1) Phone Screen -> (2) Initial Evaluation -> (3) Ongoing 1-hr Therapy Sessions (do NOT prescribe medication); ECW 10-min or 15-min grid; send TE to Portal, BH with requested clinician specialty. (3) Integrative Care (IC) & Warm Hand-Offs (WHO): Short-term, problem-focused therapy (up to 8 sessions, 30 min each) embedded inside Adult Medicine, Women's Health, or Pediatrics via same-day PCP Warm Hand-Off (WHO); follow-up TEs -> Portal, BH.

entity: Active Crisis Escalation, CMT Workflow & Emergency Contacts
content: ACTIVE PATIENT IN CRISIS (DO NOT SEND A ROUTINE TE — TRANSFER IMMEDIATELY): If a caller reports active domestic violence, severe depression or suicidal thoughts, onset of psychosis, mania, special needs decompensation, or acute medical symptoms in a BH setting: Directly transfer the caller to the Outbound Team right away to run the official CMT protocol (never leave a crisis caller on a long unmonitored hold). PCP Urgent Consult: Call Dr. Naalla Schreiber directly (845-806-1805 / Ext. 1450). Key Escalation Contacts: Crisis / Urgent Counseling -> Malkie (Marla) Schick (214-734-7565 | Ext. 1400); Crisis / Urgent Psychiatry -> Dr. Naalla Schreiber (845-806-1805 | Ext. 1450); IC / WHO Emergency -> Moshe Weiner (Ext. 1405); Psychiatric Nurse (All Med Refills) -> Queue, PSYCHRN / Norfleet, Shadasha SN; Medical Records -> Ilene Edwards (Ext. 1006); Clinical Coordinator -> Laura Rose (914-295-7597 | Ext. 1410). Official CMT Workflow: (1) Check for existing open TE with reason CMT; if none, create new TE with reason CMT and send to provider; (2) Notify team via Outlook email (PN team, Directors, counselor, psychiatrist) with ONLY Patient Full Name, DOB, and who the TE was sent to (DO NOT include clinical details in email); (3) If provider is out of office or end of day, also call provider cell AND contact Director; (4) Provider marks TE addressed once crisis passes.

rules.crisis_action: Transfer Immediately to Outbound Team (No Routine TE)
rules.cmt_email_rule: Name, DOB & TE Recipient ONLY (No Clinical Details)

entity: Behavioral Health Inbound TE Routing & Queue Directory
content: New or Follow-Up Psychiatry Visit (10-min grid): Send TE to Portal, BH (do NOT schedule directly). New or Follow-Up Psychotherapy / Counseling Visit (10 or 15-min grid): Send TE to Portal, BH (note clinician specialty preferences and Yiddish language needs). Integrative Care (IC) Follow-Up / Dr. Grodko Visit: Send TE to Portal, BH. Moshe Weiner (Social Worker) Reschedule / Cancel: Take down reason and send TE directly to Moamen Ibrahim (Assistant). Psychiatric Medication Refills & Clinical Calls (Mon AM - Fri 2:00 PM): Send TE to Queue, PSYCHRN / Norfleet, Shadasha SN (Shadasha handles ALL medication refills for ALL psychiatry doctors; Martin Lowery is no longer with Aizer). Psychiatric Refills (Fri after 2:00 PM & Sun — Routine): Send TE to Queue, PSYCHRN / Norfleet, Shadasha SN and advise caller it will be addressed Monday. Psychiatric Requests (Fri after 2:00 PM & Sun — Urgent): Send TE directly to Patient's Individual Psychiatrist plus email/WhatsApp per provider rules. Dr. Bliss Coverage (Sundays / Weekends): Send TE / request directly to Dr. Naalla Schreiber. Psychiatry Prior Authorizations (PA): Send TE to Rama Omar (include medication, dosage, & authorization status). Medical Records Requests: Direct ALL record requests to Ilene Edwards at Ext. 1006 (do NOT disclose diagnoses, prescriptions, or procedures). Therapy Termination or Counselor Transfer Request: Send TE to Primary Counselor (reason: termination of therapy or transfer therapy request) & Director of Counseling (Malkie Schick).

PRIVACY MANDATE: NEVER give provider cell phone numbers to patients or family members, and NEVER include a patient's full name or DOB in WhatsApp/text messages. Norfleet, Shadasha SN (Psychiatric Nurse — Queue, PSYCHRN): Handles ALL medication refills for ALL psychiatry doctors (Dr. Schreiber, Dr. Klafter, Dr. Michaels, Dr. Bliss); route all routine psychiatric refill & clinical TEs here. Dr. Naalla Schreiber, MD (Director of Psychiatry | Ext. 1450): 10-minute slots; Administrative day is Tuesday (no patients); refills/clinical -> Queue, PSYCHRN first; covers herself daily + Dr. Bliss on weekends; handles urgent PCP consults. Dr. Andrew (Nachum) Klafter, MD: 10-minute slots; all visits are telehealth (Zoom 899-692-7602) — Sun & Thu at center; refills -> Queue, PSYCHRN; urgent issues: create TE + email/WhatsApp (NO patient name/DOB!) as he does not check ECW TEs regularly. Dr. Rachel Michaels, MD: 10-minute grid (all appts booked on 00 / 20 / 40 min marks; schedules own follow-ups during visit); refills -> Queue, PSYCHRN; does not check ECW TEs on non-Aizer days (always create TE + Outlook email for clinical/urgent matters). Dr. Michael Bliss, DO: 10-minute slots (occasionally 45-min slots for specific patients); available Mon-Fri (weekends -> contact Dr. Schreiber); refills/clinical -> Queue, PSYCHRN first.

entity: Mandatory 8-Item Refill TE Checklist, 6-Month Rule & After-Hours Escalation
content: Mandatory 8-Item TE Checklist (Include ALL 8 for Medication/Clinical Calls): (1) Caller Name (first & last); (2) Callback Phone Number; (3) Reason for Call (detailed notes); (4) Date of Last Visit (check chart); (5) Date of Next Visit (note if overdue for 6-month follow-up); (6) Preferred Pharmacy (name, address/cross streets, or phone); (7) Medication Name; (8) Medication Dosage & Instructions. Refill & Follow-Up Rules: Norfleet, Shadasha SN (Queue, PSYCHRN) handles all medication refills for all psychiatry doctors. Check chart for last visit/upcoming follow-up; if overdue, note in TE so BH team can schedule. 6-Month Minimum Follow-Up Policy: If patient refuses follow-up after 6+ months, advise them of the 6-month minimum follow-up policy and inform them the prescriber will decide whether to approve the refill (document everything in TE). Sunday / After-Hours Refills: Confirm if patient has enough medication until next business day -> if yes, send TE to Queue, PSYCHRN; if urgent need -> send TE + email/call psychiatrist directly. Medication Change Requests: Send TE to Queue, PSYCHRN (after hours -> contact prescriber directly or Dr. Schreiber). After-Hours Tiered Escalation: (1) Contact specific treating provider directly via UNITE -> (2) If unreachable, escalate to Department Director (Malkie Schick at 214-734-7565 / Ext. 1400 for Counseling; Dr. Naalla Schreiber at 845-806-1805 / Ext. 1450 for Psychiatry) -> (3) When active, NOTIFY MD follows the on-call tree.

entity: Cancellations (2-Strike Policy), Waitlists, Yiddish Interpreter & Clinical Flow
content: Cancellation & No-Show Rules: CANC = Patient calls the day BEFORE appointment -> set CANC, document reason, send TE to Portal, BH (or Moamen Ibrahim if Moshe Weiner). N/S = Patient misses without calling OR cancels SAME DAY -> set N/S, send TE to Portal, BH. PROV CANC = Provider cancels -> set PROV CANC (never mark N/S). 2-Strike Policy Script: Advise caller that after 2 no-shows or cancelled visits they may lose their scheduled slot. Confirmations & Privacy: Confirmed day before (Friday for Sunday visits); speak ONLY to patient/guardian; never name BH on voicemails (give main Aizer number and say 'Press 6, then 1'); ensure Emergency Contact is not patient's own number. Referrals & Waitlists: Close referral in Queue, Referrals (BH) only after patient attends FIRST appointment (phone screen does not count). Waitlists (Waitlist, BH-Adult, BH-Child, BH-PRN, Psychiatry): never schedule from first 3 waitlists without Director confirmation. Language Services: Yiddish interpreter is Baila Sebrow (Thu 1:00-3:00 PM reserved for provider + interpreter; Yiddish phone screens go to Moshe Weiner). Spanish & other languages: Propio Language Line (845-478-1090 | Client ID: 24822). Clinical Program Flow: Counseling starts with Phone Screen (COUNS PHONE with Faigy Ehrman) -> Initial SW Evaluation (COUNS Eva — for kids under 18, first visit is PARENTS ONLY) -> 1-hr Routine Follow-Ups (COUNS F/U; new phone screen required if >12 months gap; no routine telehealth without provider approval). IC Hours: Sun 9 AM-5 PM, Mon-Thu 9 AM-8 PM, Fri 9 AM-2 PM (30-min IC F/U up to 8 sessions; no phone screen needed after PCP IC WHO).
